 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
 Bench At Aurangabad.

entities.text:
High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
 Bench At Aurangabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
913 Anticipatory Bail Application No.1593 Of 2025
Ganesh Haridas Ubale ... Applicant
 Versus
The State Of Maharashtra And Another ...

Respondents
 .....

Shri. Sudheer Ramdas Zambare, Advocate for the Applicant
 Shri. B. B. Bhise, App for the Respondents - State.

... 
 Coram : Neeraj P. Dhote, J.
 Dated : September 11, 2025

Per Court :-
.

Since the Applicant is apprehending arrest in C.R. No.0354/2025
registered with Akole Police Station, Dist. Ahilyanagar for the offences
punishable under Sections 123, 223, 274, 275 of the Bharatiya Nyaya
Sanhita, 2023 (for short, 'Bns') and Sec. 26 (2)(iv), 27 (3)(d), 27 (3)
(e), 30(2)(a), 3 (1)(zz)(iv) and 59 of the Food Safety and Standards
Act, 2006, he has filed this Application for Anticipatory Bail.
2. Heard the learned Advocate for the Applicant and the learned APP for the State.
Perused the papers on record.
3. The investigating machinery seized the Gutkha Pan Masala, Cash and Mobiles of the concerned persons and Vehicles.
The Applicant is not named in the FIR.
There is nothing to show that as to how the Applicant  2 is connected with the said crime.

Except the offence punishable under Ganesh Haridas Ubale vs The State Of Maharashtra And Another on 11 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/44211384/
1 Section 123 of the BNS, rest of the Sections are bailable.

sentences.text: As far as the Applicant is concerned, the essential ingredients for the offence punishable under Section 123 are not attracted.

The Co-accused by name Atik alias Akib alias Don Mohammed Shaikh who is also not named in the FIR, is protected by this Court by order dated 14.08.2025 passed in Anticipatory Bail Application No.1409 of 2025.

entities.text: Atik alias Akib alias Don Mohammed Shaikh
entities.label: OTHER_PERSON

sentences.text: Hence, the Applicant is protected by the following Interim order on the same terms and conditions.

ORDER (i) Until adjourned date of hearing, in the event of arrest of the Applicant Ganesh Haridas Ubale in connection with C.R. No.0354/2025 registered with Akole Police Station, District Ahilyanagar, for the offences punishable under Sections 26(2)(iv), 27(3)(d), 27(3)(e), 30(2)
(a), 3(1)(zz)(iv) and 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (for short 'the said Act') and under Section 123, 223, 274 and 275 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, he is directed to be released on bail on furnishing PR bond in the sum of Rs. 20,000/- (Rupees Twenty Thousand Only)
with one or more sureties in the like amount.
(ii) The Applicant shall attend the concerned Police Station on every Monday at 11.30 am, until the further orders and shall cooperate with the investigation.
(iii) The Applicant shall furnish details of residential address and other contact details such as the mobile number etc. to the concerned Police Station.
If there is any change in the contact details, the same shall be immediately informed to the concerned Police Station.

(iv) The Applicant shall not leave the jurisdiction of the competent Court without prior permission,
until further orders.

(v) He shall not contact and/or influence the witness/es and/or tamper with the evidence in any manner whatsoever.
4. Issue notice to the Respondents, returnable on 30.09.2025.
The learned APP waives service of notice for Respondent Nos.1 and 2 - State.
( NEERAJ P. DHOTE, J. ) GGP Signed by: Gajanan G. Punde
